main_text.l: Mandata, & Edicta, in publicis Comitiis promulgata, aut aliàs edita; inde ab institutione primæ Monarchiæ Germanæ usque ad D. N. Imp. Cæs. MATTHIAM P.F. Aug. P P. inclusive, sub Sacratissimæ Majestatis ejus auspiciis collecta, & partim ex publicis monumentis, partim ex Ordinum Imperii Archivis,

In quibus quidquid de Jurisdictione Imperii & Ecclesiæ, potestate Imperatoris & Papæ, auctoritate & libertate Regum, & cæterorum <i>Imperii Occidentalis Ordinum, per Magnam Germaniam, id est, Theutoniam, Franciam, Italiam, Hispaniam, Angliam, Hungariam, Poloniam, Bohemiam, Daniam, &c. de juribus civilibus & feudalibus, Pace religiosa ac profana, aliisque rebus omnibus ad Ecclesiam & Politiam spectantibus, ab Anno Orbis conditi MDCCCXII. usque ad præsentem MDCXIII. Christi nati, constitutum & sancitum est, sive comprehenditur.
Hisce turbulentis rebus & præsentibus controversiis decidendis apprimè commodus.
Cum Repertorio juris constituti locupletissimo juxta ordinem materiarum digesto.
Ex singulari gratia & privilegio Imperiali, Domino Auctori clementissimè concesso.
In Bibliopolio Petri Kopffii Civis & Bibliopolæ ibidem : Typis Johannis Jacobi

page.notes: The title page is set in black, red and italic type; the faint red lines are only partly legible and are marked as illegible. The line "In quibus" is doubtful in its first word. The lowest red line at the foot is cut off. The coat of arms is a woodcut with a double-headed eagle, crowned helmet and surrounding shields; there is no printed text in it. The handwritten inscription at the top left, the round library stamp at the lower left and the red seal at the right are not transcribed. The large black-letter title above the coat of arms is largely lost in the scan and is left out as illegible.
